name: MaskGaussian
definition: A method that models 3D Gaussians as probabilistic entities rather than permanently removing them, utilizing them according to their probability of existence to mitigate sub-optimized reconstruction from deterministic pruning.
summary: MaskGaussian is a differentiable rendering method that uses learnable inclusion probabilities to prune 3D Gaussians during alpha-compositing, allowing masked primitives to receive gradients and avoid sub-optimized reconstruction.
